name: Massage Gary St.John, L.M.T.
address: 27499 Riverview Center Blvd, Bonita Springs, FL 34134, United States (inside Riverview Executive Suites)
website_check: Google Maps listing shows no website field at all (just 'Add website' / 'Add missing information'). Tried massagegarystjohn.com and garystjohnmassage.com; both fail to resolve (DNS error, connection refused). Web search for 'Gary St.John massage Bonita Springs LMT Riverview' returned no matches for this specific therapist (search results were generic Bonita Springs massage directory listings unrelated to him), confirming no public website, Instagram, or Facebook page could be found. No Instagram handle found via web search either (direct IG profile lookups are blocked in this environment, confirmed independently against unrelated test accounts, so this was not usable as a channel for this business or the other business built in this batch). has_own_site: false confirmed.
hours: Mon-Sun 9am-7pm (listed as open every day on Google)
booking_channel: Phone only: (239) 734-1900. No online booking platform found.
owner_note: Business is named directly after the therapist, Gary St.John, L.M.T. (Licensed Massage Therapist). Google lists the business as LGBTQ+ friendly.
services_observed: Therapeutic massage (named directly in multiple reviews: 'A fantastic experience', 'therapeutic massage' tagged on 5 reviews)
Hot stone massage (tagged on 3 reviews: 'hot stones')
Holistic massage / stress and muscle-tension relief (tagged on reviews: 'holistic massage', 'muscle tension relief', 'neck pain relief')
Treatment room set with warm lamps, a tropical/beach-themed privacy screen, and calming decor (photo evidence, assets/raw/room-1.jpg, room-2.jpg, room-3.jpg, room-door.jpg)
services_note: No public price list exists anywhere for this business (no website, no booking platform). Site follows the adapted 'se cotiza, escribenos' pattern: service names are real (from Google review tags), no prices are shown, and the only booking channel is the real phone number.
booking_platform_note: No Booksy, Fresha, Vagaro, GlossGenius, Mangomint, or Square listing found for this business under this name/address. Google Maps itself shows no 'Book online' button, only the phone number.

source_of_data.discovery: CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "massage therapist" --location "Bonita Springs, FL" --limit 8 --min-rating 4.5 --min-reviews 10
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 5.0, reviews 35, phone, address, hours, website null, 'LGBTQ+ friendly' attribute, 20 photos listed in the Maps album
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 3 unique verbatim 5-star reviews after de-dup, plus service-mention tag counts used to describe real services without inventing a menu
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 25 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos pulled, visually curated one by one with the Read tool. Kept 6: reception/signage desk showing the shared 'Riverview Executive Suites' building lobby (assets/raw/reception.jpg), the treatment room from 3 different angles with its tropical beach-mural privacy screen and warm lamp (assets/raw/room-1.jpg, room-2.jpg, room-3.jpg), a view toward the treatment room door (assets/raw/room-door.jpg), and the building exterior with signage (assets/raw/exterior.jpg). Discarded: a generic shared-building courtyard/patio photo and a generic shared-building waiting lounge photo (both show the office building's common areas, not anything specific to this massage practice, so they would mislead rather than inform), a promotional 4-photo collage image that duplicates room shots already captured individually and includes a posed shot of the therapist himself by the table (collage composites and owner portraits are not used as gallery tiles per the photo curation rules), and one image that was the business's own logo/business-card collage, not a real photo.

brand_vibe: Calm, neutral, coastal-tropical treatment room: grey carpet, warm amber lamps, a tall folding privacy screen printed with a palm-tree beach photo, seashells and starfish as decor accents. Built on a light, warm-neutral base with a soft ocean-teal accent (coastal/tranquil palette), distinct from the other warm-gold palette used for the other business built in this same batch.
